Interface CookieAbility

All Known Implementing Classes:
GhostAbility, JumpBoostAbility, MagneticAbility
public interface CookieAbility
Base interface for all cookie abilities. Ability system uses the Strategy Pattern: each cookie can have different ability behavior without changing the Cookie class itself.
